functions.args: p_actor uuid
functions.name: active_assignment
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.active_assignment(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS user_assignments
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select a from user_assignments a join profiles p on p.id=a.profile_id join positions po on po.id=a.position_id and po.is_active join organizational_units u on u.id=a.unit_id and u.is_active
 where a.profile_id=p_actor and p.is_active and a.is_active
 and (a.start_date is null or a.start_date<=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta')::date) and (a.end_date is null or a.end_date>=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta')::date)
 order by a.start_date desc nulls last limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.can_backdate(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from app.active_assignment(p_actor) a join positions p on p.id=a.position_id
 where p.is_active and p.code in ('GM','SM','DIR'))
$function$

functions.args: p_request uuid
functions.name: can_read_cancellation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.can_read_cancellation(p_request uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from profiles where id=auth.uid() and is_active) and exists(
 select 1 from cancellation_requests cr where cr.id=p_request and (
 app.is_super_admin() or cr.requested_by=auth.uid()
 or exists(select 1 from cancellation_authorizations ca where ca.request_id=cr.id and ca.authorizer_id=auth.uid())
 or app.can_read_letter_for(auth.uid(),cr.letter_id)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.can_read_letter(p_letter uuid)

$function$

functions.args: p_actor uuid, p_letter uuid
functions.name: can_read_letter_for
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.can_read_letter_for(p_actor uuid, p_letter uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
select exists(select 1 from profiles where id=p_actor and is_active) and exists (
 select 1 from letters l where l.id=p_letter and (
 l.creator_id=p_actor or l.signer_id=p_actor
 or (l.recipient_user_id=p_actor and l.status in ('NUMBERED','CANCELLED'))
 or exists(select 1 from approval_steps a where a.letter_id=l.id and a.approver_id=p_actor and a.status<>'WAITING')
 or exists(select 1 from signature_requests s where s.letter_id=l.id and s.signer_id=p_actor)
 or exists(select 1 from cancellation_requests cr where cr.letter_id=l.id and (cr.requested_by=p_actor or exists(select 1 from cancellation_authorizations ca where ca.request_id=cr.id and ca.authorizer_id=p_actor)))
 or exists(select 1 from dispositions d where (d.letter_id=l.id and d.recipient_id=p_actor) or (d.response_letter_id=l.id and d.giver_id=p_actor and d.submitted_at is not null))
 ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.is_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

$function$

functions.name: audit_logs_immutable
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_logs_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'audit_logs bersifat append-only' using errcode = 'P0001'; end $function$

functions.args: p_pattern text, p_seq integer, p_issued_at timestamp with time zone, p_unit text, p_position text, p_type text
functions.name: build_official_number
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_official_number(p_pattern text, p_seq integer, p_issued_at timestamp with time zone, p_unit text, p_position text, p_type text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(p_pattern,
    '{URUT}', lpad(p_seq::text, 3, '0')),
    '{TGL}',  to_char(p_issued_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'DD')),
    '{BLN}',  to_char(p_issued_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'MM')),
    '{THN}',  to_char(p_issued_at at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta', 'YYYY')),
    '{UNIT}', coalesce(p_unit, '')),
    '{JABATAN}', coalesce(p_position, '')),
    '{JENIS}', coalesce(p_type, ''))
$function$
